name: job-search-os
description: The AI operating system for a job search in any profession: a command center and five end-to-end jobs — tailor and apply, work my inbox, prep for an interview, follow up and negotiate, run my weekly review — with a check card before every application, a people tracker for referrals, sourced company briefs, mock interviews, and a funnel report. Drafts into Gmail, Calendar, and Drive with your approval; every claim traces to your own record.
